review.reviewBody:
Honestly, this trip was so much more special than I expected. 🤍

I was travelling alone, and from the very beginning to the very end, I felt so surrounded, looked after and welcomed by the whole JVTO team. Everyone was so kind, reactive and helpful, and I always felt like I could ask anything and that someone was there to help.

A very special thank you to Egy and Juan, who were honestly a true blessing during this trip. 🥹 They were always so kind, patient and thoughtful, and I laughed so much with them.

Egy deserves a special mention because he was just the sweetest. Always calm, gentle and making sure everything was okay (and that I stayed hydrated!). Honestly, the MVP of the trip 😂🤍

They also took the time to make me discover local food and little parts of Indonesian culture and language, and as someone travelling alone, I felt really lucky and privileged to experience that. It felt like so much more than just booking a tour.

The itinerary was amazing, the landscapes were incredible, the accommodation was great, and everything was so well organised. But what I will remember the most are definitely the people.

I’m so grateful for this experience and for everyone who made my first trip to Indonesia so special.

Thank you so much JVTO, and especially Egy and Juan. ❤️🇮🇩

I will definitely never forget this trip!
